Supreme Court: Skipping Party Meeting is Not Defection

The Supreme Court heard arguments in the Shiv Sena leadership dispute, with the faction led by Eknath Shinde asserting that skipping a party meeting does not constitute defection. This argument was presented to the court as part of the ongoing legal challenge concerning the party's leadership.
